description: Backlink profile summary for `<domain>` — total backlinks, referring domains, domain rank, dofollow/nofollow split, and spam score, via DataForSEO. The "how strong is this domain's link profile" overview. Example: seo_backlinks_summary({ target: "nike.com", _apiKey: "your-base64-key" })
